10k.note: Latest available SEC annual report (filed when company was BiondVax). Scinai now appears to file 20-F as foreign private issuer; pre-2024 portfolio data is largely obsolete after the BiondVax flu vaccine pivot.

ctgov.note: All 7 trials are legacy BiondVax M-001 universal influenza vaccine trials, all COMPLETED. The Phase 3 NCT03450915 failed and the program was terminated; legacy assets are not part of the active Scinai pipeline.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Scinai's current portfolio (NanoAb VHH-based antibody platform programs targeting IL-17; PC111 anti-sFasL mAb licensed from Pincell for pemphigus vulgaris and SJS/TEN) is in preclinical stage. PC111 has not yet entered human proof-of-concept; Scinai's EUR12 million FENG grant application to fund PC111 clinical entry was not approved (Nov 2025). No active P1/P2/P3 company-sponsored trials. Operating revenues come from Scinai's CDMO services rather than clinical-stage assets.
excluded_preclinical: PC111 anti-sFasL mAb for pemphigus vulgaris / SJS/TEN (preclinical, awaiting non-dilutive funding)
excluded_legacy_terminated: M-001 / Multimeric-001 universal influenza vaccine (Phase 3 NCT03450915 failed in 2020; program terminated; corporate pivot to Scinai)
